what_to_test:
Juggle Dude 1.1.0 (34) — iOS 18 compatibility

This build lowers the minimum supported version to iOS 18.0. The current counter, longest-streak leaderboard, Apple/email sign-in and five languages remain included.

• On iOS 18, try a short live recording, replay, effects and Download to Photos. Then try importing a video. Check orientation, counter and timer in the saved result.
• Keep the app open during video preparation and export on iOS 18. It keeps the screen awake while working; switching away pauses processing, which resumes when you return. If iOS closes the app, reopen the original recording and retry.
• Older systems use native frosted panels and ordinary slow motion. Enhanced smooth slow motion appears only on supported iOS versions and hardware. iOS 26 retains Liquid Glass and background processing when available.
• Join the leaderboard and record while signed in. The longest counted streak should rank; total touches stay in session history. Try clear hand stops and ground bounces between runs.
• Check Apple/email sign-in, guest mode, Pro purchase/restore and changing language without restarting.

Please report your iPhone model and iOS version with any issue. Physical iOS 18 camera and thermal testing is still needed; the minimum-OS simulator checks are not a performance benchmark.
